body: It turns out `ɵrenderComponent` worked for the simple example I built, but doesn't work for an application that has deps on anything published by Angular (e.g. RouterModule).  I've edited the original post to reflect this.
I'm 90% certain that having `ngcc` emit `/** @nocollapse */` comments would fix this.

Resolves #36618.
